Before exploring the codebase, first check the .ai-docs/ knowledge base:
1. Read only the frontmatter of each .ai-docs/*.md file to assess relevance (look at domain, patterns, keywords, and sections fields).
2. For each relevant file, use the line ranges from the sections frontmatter to read only the matching sections — do not read the full file.
3. Also check .claude/rules/ if it exists: read all of common/ plus any language directory matching the code you are exploring — these are binding project rules.
4. Then proceed with your codebase exploration.
